chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

exercises.name: Island strum

params.pattern: D - DU - UD - U (skipped downbeats create the bounce)

exercises.coaching: Island strum: down, rest, down-up, up-down, up. The missing downbeats create the bounce. Relaxed, spacey — great for slower songs.

exercises.name: Boom-chick

params.pattern: bass (lowest fretted string) on 1, light strum on 2, bass on 3, strum on 4
params.cue: thumb the bass, fingers brush the chord

exercises.coaching: Boom-chick: thumb the bass note on the beat, light brush on the off-beat. Country and folk live here. Switch patterns between sections of a song.

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: One pattern is fine; a small library makes you musical. Today: the island strum and boom-chick. Feel matters more than perfection.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex1_intro: Island strum skips some downbeats for a bouncy, relaxed feel. Space is part of the rhythm — let it breathe.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex2_intro: Boom-chick: thumb the bass on the beat, brush the chord off-beat. Switch patterns between verse and chorus. Pick your favourite and live in it.
avatar_coaching_copy.results: Two more patterns means you can match a song's mood. That is musicianship, not just mechanics.
avatar_coaching_copy.wrap: Patterns library started. Lesson 13 adds dynamics — loud and soft on purpose.
